*“High cleanliness standards are recognized when **quarterly sanitation inspections reach 10 or more** **alongside at least 3 infection control specialists**.”*

1. **Quarterly sanitation inspections ≥ 10**  
2. **At least 3 infection control specialists**  

Since there is no “or” clause, there is only **one group** containing both conditions.
